subject: Whistic onboarding: evidence ownership & presign shortlist for HelixPay EU subsidiary
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixpay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixpay.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Whistic portal: onboarding & evidence ownership for HelixPay subsidiary

Hi Olga —

Quick context: HelixPay just spun up an EU subsidiary (BrightGate) that needs to be added to our Whistic profile. We're starting with a minimal proof set so the BrightGate team can finish procurement. Two asks: 1) can Redwood claim evidence ownership for certain CAIQ/SIG items on our behalf (we want to avoid duplicative uploads), and 2) can you confirm a short presign window so we can push the initial artifacts to S3 for ingestion?

I've attached a small SOC 2 excerpt and a CSV manifest of candidate artifacts. If you can point us at the top ~10 documents you'd accept for initial onboarding (SOC snippets, syslog manifest, SSO screenshots, KMS statement), that would speed our intake. Also note BrightGate will not share a full SOC2 until after procurement — they'd prefer redacted excerpts for now.

Thanks — appreciate any guidance and a quick checklist we can hand the devs.

Liam O'Connor
Security Programs, HelixPay
liam.oconnor@helixpay.com
Attachment stubs: soc2-excerpt-Helix.pdf (pdf), whistic-manifest.csv (csv)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixpay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic portal: onboarding & evidence ownership for HelixPay subsidiary

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the attachments. Short answers up-front: yes, we can claim responsibility for a subset of CAIQ answers where Redwood controls the runtime and network controls; and yes, we can accept a presign window for initial artifacts.

Plan suggestion:
- Jonas: map the manifest to CAIQ/SIG categories and flag items we can own vs items we need raw evidence for.
- Mina: coordinate presign window and minimal S3 ACLs; we'll require a 72-hour upload window and a single manifest file with checksums.
- From Redwood: we'll provide a 'minimal onboarding checklist' (top 10 artifact types) and an explicit owner roster that HelixPay can publish in Whistic.

Action items for HelixPay:
1) Confirm whether the SOC2 excerpt includes the CC controls page (helps us map scope).
2) Share the list of contacts who can sign evidence transfer statements (name + email).

Jonas / Mina — can you each reply with ETA (EOD today preferable) so I can get HelixPay unblocked?

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixpay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic portal: onboarding & evidence ownership for HelixPay subsidiary

On Thu, Jun 28, 2028 at 10:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Plan suggestion:
> - Jonas: map the manifest to CAIQ/SIG categories and flag items we can own vs items we need raw evidence for.

Thanks — quick mapping summary below (preliminary):
- Items likely we can claim (Redwood-controlled): TLS certchain verification, runtime isolation description, public key pinning statements, API gateway ACL screenshots.
- Items requiring customer-supplied evidence: SOC2 control narratives, KMS keyowners screenshots (custody evidence), internal syslog retention policy excerpts if HelixPay wants vendor-provided copies.

Top 10 prioritized artifact candidates from the attached manifest (recommended initial batch):
1) SOC2 excerpt: CC3 / CC7 control pages (redacted)
2) API gateway ACL screenshot (edge rule set)
3) SSO configuration screenshot (SAML issuer + cert thumbprint)
4) KMS ownership statement (signed PDF)
5) Syslog retention delta manifest (csv row references)
6) Network ingress whitelist (cidr doc)
7) Backup/restore runbook excerpt (ops doc)
8) Dataflow diagram with processing boundaries (redacted)

I'll finish the CAIQ mapping and flag exact question IDs we can pre-answer (expected later today). HubSpot record: HS-987654 has the procurement ticket and will be our canonical link.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Onboarding, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixpay.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic portal: onboarding & evidence ownership for HelixPay subsidiary

Quick follow-up on presign windows and minimal S3 requirements:
- We can provision a presign/upload window for 72 hours. Upload manifest must contain SHA256 checksums and a single top-level folder per BrightGate tenant.
- ACL: objects uploaded to the presign bucket must be encrypted with customer-provided KMS key or our designated onboarding key (we prefer customer-held KMS).
- We will only ingest files listed in the manifest; anything else will be quarantined.

Constraints/asks from Redwood ops team: please redact or remove any PII from SOC extracts before upload. If HelixPay cannot redact, we will accept a signed statement that the file is for onboarding review only and will not be stored beyond 90 days.

ETA: I can create the presign window and provide the signed presign URLs by tomorrow morning (2028-06-29 09:00 PT) once we have the canonical owner email list.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Platform Security, Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: whistic-manifest.csv

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixpay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic portal: onboarding & evidence ownership for HelixPay subsidiary

Thanks all — this is great. Confirming: BrightGate will produce redacted SOC2 CC pages tonight and Sara (cc'd) will send the canonical owner roster by 2028-06-29 17:00 PT. A 72-hour presign window works fine; we'll aim for uploads by end of day Friday.

One question for Jonas: when you finish the CAIQ mapping, can you mark which question IDs Redwood is willing to own answers for so HelixPay can accept those in Whistic on our behalf? That will avoid duplicate answers across vendor and parent profiles.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Security Programs, HelixPay
